gamification_enabled.description: When enabled, net check-in streaks and achievements are tracked for this club.

leaderboard_enabled.description: When enabled, the net streak leaderboard is visible to club members.

net_schedule.description: The club's net cadence. Used to determine when a missed net resets a member's streak.

qualifying_checkin_types.description: JSON array of check-in types that count toward streaks: standard, late, guest, mobile. Defaults to all.

radio_services.description: Which radio service(s) this club is for. A club can be GMRS, HAM, or both.

stripe_account_id.description: The club owner's connected Stripe account id (Express). Set by the onboarding function.

stripe_charges_enabled.description: Whether the club's Stripe account is fully onboarded and can receive charges. Synced from Stripe via account.updated webhook.
